articleText:
[Hacker News — github.com]
DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale.

Required for a complete inference service (not included in this release):

Prerequisites Linux GCC >= 13.0 Python 3.12 CUDA 13 (NVIDIA only) CANN 9.2 (Ascend only) Build from source Before building DeepInfer, please create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment.

# Use `ascend` instead for the Ascend platform # Keep it exported in the environment where you run DeepInfer export DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR=nvidia ./build.sh Offline inference The default checkpoint, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 , is downloaded into the Hugging Face cache on the first run; set DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 to run from a local copy instead.

python examples/offline_inference.py See examples for details.

Prefill Decode Measured on 4 SM100 GPUs for prefill and 64 for decode — each within one scale-up domain. To reproduce the benchmarks, see run_sweep.sh .

DeepInfer is released under the Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE for details.

DeepInfer was originally built primarily on vLLM , with additional inspiration from SGLang and TensorRT-LLM . We thank their developers.
